items.description:
Haj and Umrah pilgrims, work visa holders and those planning to stay in Saudi Arabia for more than six months will be required to carry a National Database and Registration Authority-linked vaccination certificate from Sept 25 onwards when travelling from Karachi’s Jinnah International Airport, an official said.
The development came as Border Health Services-Pakistan (BHS-P) extended the deadline for the application of the requirement — which initially applied only to Haj and Umrah pilgrims — from Sept 14 to 10am on Sept 25.

items.description:

items.title: Sindh Assembly passes LG law amendment amid opposition uproar
items.description:
KARACHI: The Sindh Assembly on Monday passed the Sindh Local Government (LG) Act 2026 (Amendment) Bill amid loud sloganeering and protests by members of all opposition parties.
The bill aims to introduce key changes to the 2013 local government law, including allowing outgoing mayors and chairmen to continue as administrators after the expiry of their terms.

items.description:
KARACHI: The Sindh High Court (SHC) on Monday suspended Pakistan Medical and Dental Council’s (PMDC) directives ordering Afghan medical students to return to their country until the next hearing on Sept 29.

items.title: Millions of livelihoods at stake as Himalayas approach tipping point, study finds
items.description:
The Himalayas are approaching a tipping point as glaciers melt faster than a decade ago, threatening water security as ​the region approaches “peak water” by mid-century, according to a study ‌released this month.
The findings come after the collapse of a Himalayan glacier in late August along the Nepal-Tibet border, which caused cascading landslides and flash floods in the ​valleys below. At least 1,300 people have been confirmed dead ​and more than 5,300 are missing across Nepal and China’s ⁠Tibet region.

items.title: Pakistan fined, docked 11 WTC points for slow over-rate in Birmingham Test
items.description:
Pakistan have been fined 50 per cent of their match fee, and penalised 11 World Test Championship points for maintaining a slow over-rate during the third and final Test against England in Birmingham, the International Cricket Council (ICC) said on Monday.
